description: Scalable Gaussian Process for Learning Non-Ergodic Ground Motion Model from Physics-Based Simulations with Application to Power Infrastructure Assessment is a dataset listed in DesignSafe Data Depot (published projects), a research data repository for natural hazards engineering under the section "other", published or maintained by Jinyan Zhao, University of California Berkeley (berkeley.edu). This data repository contains the code and data produced for the manuscript titled "Scalable Gaussian Process for Learning Non-Ergodic Ground Motion Model from Physics-Based Simulations with Application to Power Infrastructure Assessment". Below is the abstract of the manuscript. Coverage: as described in the project (site or event named in the description). DesignSafe files it as a "other" project with 6 top-level files. Its DOI is 10.17603/ds2-tksx-c844. Keywords: Gaussian Process, non-ergodic ground motion, earthquake, physics-based simulations. Published 2026-05-19. Facility named: SimCenter. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is 3-Clause BSD License. Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support structural performance, hazard exposure and resilience studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-designsafe-data-depot-repository.
